Who we are

Rooted in Anacostia.
Built for the long haul.

Saint John Community Development Corporation has served Ward 8 since 2007 — expanding education, health, and opportunity for the residents of Anacostia.

Est. 2007 · Anacostia

Our mission

Dedicated service through empowering our community.

Saint John Community Development Corporation, Inc. (SJCDC) is a Washington, D.C. nonprofit corporation, incorporated in November 2007 and recognized by the IRS as a 501(c)(3) public charity in 2008.

SJCDC provides access to services and facilities that sustain and enhance people's quality of life. Our long-term goal is to empower the community with positive, life-long improvements — primarily in Anacostia and across Washington, D.C.

We serve children, youth, teenagers, young adults, and adults, offering the opportunity to take part in a variety of programs throughout the year. Increased self-confidence and stronger community ties are benefits that reach well beyond any single service.

What guides us

Our purpose & values

Dedicated Service

We meet real needs with consistency and care — showing up for our neighbors year after year, in ways big and small.

Empowerment

Through education, health, and skills, we help residents build the knowledge and confidence they need to thrive in school, work, and life.

Community Involvement

Local service making a world of difference. We believe lasting change is built together, with and for the people of Ward 8.

Our story

A history of showing up

2007
Founded
Saint John CDC is born
Rooted in the ministry of St. John CME Church, SJCDC receives its Seal of Incorporation on November 15, 2007, to serve the Anacostia community.
2008
Milestone
501(c)(3) status secured
The IRS grants federal tax exemption in February 2008, and a Certificate of Tax Exemption follows in September — establishing SJCDC as a public charity.
2010
Community
Town Hall & partnerships
With St. John CME Church, SJCDC hosts a Town Hall — “Good to Be Better, Better to Be Best” — on economic, education, and health & wellness development, forging partnerships across D.C.
2010s
Programs
Education, health & outreach
Tutoring, literacy, computer training, a Saturday Women's Group, diabetes and heart-disease workshops, plus job fairs (110+ attendees) and holiday giving to families.
2013
Health
HIV testing with Unity Health Care
In collaboration with Unity Health Care, SJCDC supports community HIV testing at Giant Food, distributing gift cards, alongside ongoing health screenings and wellness education.
2024
Partnership
1LOVE 1HEART 1COMMUNITY
SJCDC joins #FAN and St. John CME Church for the inaugural “God Speaks” day of faith, fun, and family — live music, a gift-card giveaway, free kids' activities, and a community panel.
Today
Looking ahead
A new focus, a new brand
Holding firmly to our history while becoming an answer — with renewed focus for an ever-changing community.

The corporation

Local service, lasting difference.

SJCDC is organized as a nonprofit charitable, religious, and educational organization under Section 501(c)(3). We provide educational, health, computer-training, and community services to children, teenagers, young adults, and adults — giving people the knowledge and skills they need to achieve in school and in the workplace.

The vision is one of local service making a world of difference through community involvement.

Sustainability

Built to last

Nonprofits are asked to do more with less. SJCDC plans for the long term — grounding the work in clear values, community mapping, and vision-and-mission planning so the organization can keep serving Anacostia for years to come.

We raise support through charitable giving, grants, corporate philanthropy, and community fundraising — including efforts like Give to Max Day — and welcome capital-campaign and planned-giving partners who want to invest in Ward 8's future.

Charitable giving
Individual donors are the foundation of our support.
Grants
Federal, state, local, and foundation funding for programs.
Corporate philanthropy
Local businesses investing in community wellbeing.
Community fundraising
Events and campaigns like Give to Max Day.
